title: Four-heated-microring array with grating couplers
summary: An array of four microring resonators laid out along the y-direction. Each microring includes an integrated heater and is optically connected to its own grating coupler for fiber interfacing.

blocks.notes: Place the four rings in an array along +y with uniform pitch. Each ring includes an integrated thermal tuner/heater and electrical access (pads/metal routing as supported by the PDK) within the same block. Optical coupling to an adjacent bus waveguide suitable for routing to a grating coupler.

One grating coupler per microring path; orientation and polarization (TE/TM) and fiber angle per PDK defaults unless specified. Include short access waveguides/tapers as required by the grating coupler primitive.

wiring_notes: Instantiate four identical channels: (grating coupler) <-> (waveguide routing) <-> (bus-coupled microring with heater).
Arrange channels as a vertical array (varying y) with consistent spacing to meet DRC and fiber array pitch if applicable.
Provide electrical routing/pads for each ring heater as part of each microring-with-heater block; avoid separate heater blocks.

objective.target_behavior: Four independent thermally tunable microring channels, each accessible via its own grating coupler connection.
